reason: My broker app already buys the same index funds for me every month for free, and I barely look at it, which is how I like it. I don't see what I'd be paying a monthly fee for, and a cartoon pet handling my retirement money feels like a toy, not a tool.
objection: A Tamagotchi feels unserious for money, and letting an AI agent invest and pay for me with real dollars through a broker partner nobody has named yet is a big ask for something I'd pay extra for.
would_change_my_mind: A named, licensed, insured broker holding the money, plus a few years of the agent's record showing it actually beats my plain monthly index buys after the fee.
